name: Indalu Taresa
tagline: I build accessible, intelligent software — from AI systems for underserved communities to production-grade microservices.
summary: Senior Software Engineering student at Abu Dhabi University with 3+ years of freelance experience across full-stack development, data analysis, and AI engineering. Currently building AI tools that make learning and daily life more accessible.
